About this collection & keeping it up to date

Coverage. The collection currently contains 1,345 unique PubMed records. The matching affiliation must contain “Centre/Center for Kidney Research” and Sydney, Westmead, New South Wales or NSW. Update from PubMed searches all available years and refreshes both new and existing citations. Existing records whose local affiliation can no longer be verified are retained with a review label.

Project associations. Suggestions are based on explicit names or acronyms in titles, abstracts, source keywords or collective authors. A mention can refer to background work. NAVKIDS², KCAD, ARDAC and TACKLE-IT are initial projects; SONG, BEAT-CKD and CARI are programmes. This is not a complete directory. Each record’s details show the evidence for its suggestions.

Record types. Corrections, retracted publications, retraction notices and preprints are labelled where present. Distinct PubMed records sharing a DOI are retained; duplicate DOIs are flagged in the EndNote export. Journal issue years can differ from online publication years.

Using EndNote. “Export to EndNote” downloads the currently filtered records as a RIS file. In EndNote Online, use Collect → Import References and choose RefMan RIS. Suggested associations are preserved as searchable keywords, such as CKR_PROJECT_CANDIDATE_NAVKIDS2. RIS import does not automatically create project groups. Import each record once to avoid duplicates.

Updates and saving. Click Update from PubMed to refresh this page. The download may take several minutes. Keep the page open until it finishes; the old collection is retained if the download is interrupted. Successful updates are kept in this browser when local storage is available. Local-file browser storage is not guaranteed and does not follow the file to another device. Save updated HTML downloads a complete, portable copy with the current collection embedded. It does not silently overwrite your original file. Updates run only when you click the button; no scheduled task has been enabled.

The page does not edit your EndNote account. You can export selected records to EndNote after updating. Researcher names, ORCID identifiers and membership dates are needed to find additional papers that omit the Centre’s affiliation. Older PubMed records often contain only the first author’s affiliation. A PubMed search alert is also available.

Sources. Each record links directly to PubMed and its DOI where available. The initial project directory comes from the CKR research page. See the EndNote documentation for account and interface features.
